name: Roland SD-90
description: Roland SD-90 Studio Canvas (GM2 sound module and audio interface), native mode: the setup, system and audio blocks, the whole temporary Multitimbre with its 32 parts and 32 MIDI channels, and part 1's temporary Patch (four tones) and Rhythm set, from the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: SD-90 MIDI Implementation (version 1.02, December 12, 2001)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from SD-90_MI.pdf (sha256 ebe9294cefcda57b5ac40fc716459593b17c02800882c70d42a978c1b19e2d47). Model ID 00 48, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Model id 00 48: two bytes, as the prose (p5), the RQ1 and DT1 byte tables (p5, p6), the address map heading (p7) and every printed message (p19-21) give it.
Identity Reply (p6): the byte table says family code 48H 01H; the message line prints 10H 01H. 48 01 is used.

The p19 DT1 example sets 10 00 04 00 and calls it Chorus Type; the offset table (p7) makes that Reverb Type. Its RQ1 examples disagree with the tables too: <Example 2> gives Multitimbre Part a size of 00 00 00 31H where the table's Total Size is 00 00 00 40H (p11), and <Example 3> puts part 1's Temporary Patch at 11 20 00 00 and its Rhythm at 11 30 00 00, and part 32's at 14 60 00 00 / 14 70 00 00, where the address map has 11 00 00 00 / 11 10 00 00 and 18 60 00 00 / 18 70 00 00, and calls the rhythm keys "Rhythm Tone 1 … 4" (p20). The scale-tune text beside them names the SC-8820 (p21).

Two parameters are marked "-- Receive Only --" in their names: Setup 00 00 (SD-90 Native ON, 0) and Audio Common AFX Parameter 00 01 (AFX Time out, 1-15). They are laid out as the map prints them; a dump may not carry a meaningful value for them.

Most System, Audio, Multitimbre, Part and MIDI rows print a third line, "default: (wire) shown", under their display line (p7-p11). The map keeps it as part of the display text, so a choice's last label carries it ("ON default: (1) ON", choice id ondefault1on) and a printed range followed by it is not read as a range (Part Pan "L64 - 63R default:( 0) CENTER" stays a plain 0-127 number with that text as its description). Wire values and ranges are unaffected. Part Legato Switch and Part Portamento Switch (0-2) print a default of (64), outside their range.
Printed names kept as printed: "Syhth Mute" (Audio Mixer, 00 32), "Part Vibrate Rate/Depth/Delay" (Multitimbre Part 00 22-00 24).

No example message is checked: The only single-parameter DT1 example (p19, Chorus Type = DELAY) writes to 10 00 04 00, which the manual's own Multitimbre offset table (p7) gives to Multitimbre Common Reverb (Reverb Type); Chorus is at 00 02 00. The other printed DT1 (p21, part 1 Scale Tune C-B, 12 bytes at 10 00 20 33) agrees with the map but sets twelve parameters in one message, which an example (one parameter, one value) cannot state.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): part1.patch.common, part1.patch.chorus, part1.patch.reverb, part1.patch.mfx, part1.patch.tmt, part1.patch.tone1, part1.patch.tone2, part1.patch.tone3, part1.patch.tone4, part1.rhythm.common, part1.rhythm.chorus, part1.rhythm.reverb, part1.rhythm.mfx, part1.rhythm.key35, part1.rhythm.key36, part1.rhythm.key37, part1.rhythm.key38, part1.rhythm.key39, part1.rhythm.key40, part1.rhythm.key41, part1.rhythm.key42, part1.rhythm.key43, part1.rhythm.key44, part1.rhythm.key45, part1.rhythm.key46, part1.rhythm.key47, part1.rhythm.key48, part1.rhythm.key49, part1.rhythm.key50, part1.rhythm.key51, part1.rhythm.key52, part1.rhythm.key53, part1.rhythm.key54, part1.rhythm.key55, part1.rhythm.key56, part1.rhythm.key57, part1.rhythm.key58, part1.rhythm.key59, part1.rhythm.key60, part1.rhythm.key61, part1.rhythm.key62, part1.rhythm.key63, part1.rhythm.key64, part1.rhythm.key65, part1.rhythm.key66, part1.rhythm.key67, part1.rhythm.key68, part1.rhythm.key69, part1.rhythm.key70, part1.rhythm.key71, part1.rhythm.key72, part1.rhythm.key73, part1.rhythm.key74, part1.rhythm.key75, part1.rhythm.key76, part1.rhythm.key77, part1.rhythm.key78, part1.rhythm.key79, part1.rhythm.key80, part1.rhythm.key81.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: the Control Change, RPN and NRPN messages (p1-4) and the GS-mode (model 42H) addresses are not mapped
coverage.parts: the Multitimbre Part block and the MIDI block for all 32 parts/channels; the temporary Patch and Rhythm for Part 1 only. Parts 2-32's are not laid out: Temporary Patch/Rhythm (Multitimbre Mode Part n) is at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) x 00 20 00 00 (11 20 00 00, 11 40 00 00, 11 60 00 00, 12 00 00 00 … 18 60 00 00), with the Patch at +00 00 00 and the Rhythm at +10 00 00 inside it
coverage.rhythmKeys: rhythm tones for keys 35-81 (the General MIDI percussion keys) only. The map has keys 21-108: Rhythm Tone (Key # k) is at the part's area + 10 00 00 + 00 10 00 + (k-21) x 00 02 00, so for Part 1 keys 21-34 are at 11 10 10 00-11 10 2A 00 and keys 82-108 at 11 11 0A 00-11 11 3E 00; all eighty-eight would be 12,496 parameters
coverage.toneTypes: a part plays a Patch or a Rhythm set, never both; Part 1's two areas are both laid out at their addresses, and both are read on request rather than at connect, since a request the SD-90 cannot answer gets no reply (p5) and the startup read stops at the first one that times out
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, AFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
